crypto.synthesis: This week's crypto commentary highlights a divergence between those focused on macro liquidity and government policy as drivers of Bitcoin's price, and those emphasizing technical indicators and regulatory developments. While some analysts see a confirmed bottom and a bullish future driven by fiat debasement and AI integration, others remain deeply skeptical, viewing current rallies as unsustainable and pointing to new competitive threats like tokenized stocks. The failure of the CLARITY Act has also sparked debate, with some seeing it as a positive for free markets and others as a setback for regulatory clarity.
